name: frame-lab
description: Compare compatible Minecraft frame captures, catch invalid measurements, and inspect a supported local benchmark setup. Inspect frame-time tails and true 1% lows; differing profiles are flagged before a winner is reported. Live capture requires a supported macOS Minecraft installation; saved evidence can be analyzed in an execution-capable environment.
